serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Big Daddy: Yes, it’s me.
???: *muzzled*
Big Daddy: I accomplished my mission.
???: *muzzled*
Big Daddy: The technology is now safe with me…
???: *muzzled*
Big Daddy: With it… yes, the Connoisseurs can finally be revived.
???: *muzzled*
Big Daddy: The sexbot I handed to the CIA was a fake…
???: *muzzled*
Big Daddy: Before American lab geeks notice, I will be long gone. 
???: *muzzled*
Big Daddy: Yes, turns out the president isn’t as smart as he thinks.
???: *muzzled*
Big Daddy: No, I couldn't act faster. I was suspecting that Anon’s sexbot was our target from the beginning, but I couldn’t act until I convinced my handler that it was what we were looking for. 
???: *muzzled*
Big Daddy: Listen, all of this wouldn’t be necessary if you didn’t get your ass kicked by a nun and her mobility scooter.
???: *muzzled*
Big Daddy: You have no idea what I sacrificed, I lost my wife because of that operation.
???: *muzzled*
Big Daddy: You are horrible at cheering people up. 
???: *muzzled*
Big Daddy: Yes. I’m hanging up. I have a custody battle to win. Call me later.
???: *muzzled*
Big Daddy: Me not seeing them in 4 years isn’t an argument, dude. I want them now. Bye.
Big Daddy: What a douche…
